title: MediSync — Complete Project Architecture
summary: Comprehensive architectural reference for the MediSync healthcare scheduling platform. Covers the FastAPI backend (auth, RBAC, services, models, CRUD, WebSocket, middleware), the Next.js 16 frontend (Redux, API clients, routing, shadcn/ui), database schema (14 tables with relationships), all API endpoints (auth, CRUD, dashboard analytics, waitlist queue), environment configuration, and project plan documentation inventory. Includes known issues and a quick-reference file location guide.

references.description: Full codebase audit session — backend, frontend, project plan analysis
